Hi Tom,

Thanks again for the quick discovery call last week — excited to show how Redwood can tighten token costs for your transaction classification flows. I know the week of Mar 15 has the US/EU DST mismatch (US springs forward earlier), so I wanted to propose slots that keep everyone in reasonable business hours across regions.

Proposed 60-min demo windows (all times shown in your local TZ unless noted):
- Tue Mar 16, 09:00 CET / 03:00 EDT (early for US) — not ideal for US ops but OK for EU heavy attendees
- Tue Mar 16, 11:00 CET / 05:00 EDT — middle-ground option
- Wed Mar 17, 15:00 CET / 11:00 EDT — US-friendly, late for EU

Attached is a quick availability grid (rdw-demo-availability-grid.pdf) and an .ics with the middle-ground slot prefilled. If these don't work, happy to run two 30-min regional sessions (APAC/EMEA + Americas) instead.

Would love a quick note on preferred slot and any participants we should include (SRE, data security, procurement).

Best,

Thanks for the options. Quick note: our EMEA team is affected by the EU DST change on Sun Mar 29, but the US shifts earlier on Mar 8 — in practice that means the week of Mar 15 will feel weird for cross-region folks. The middle-ground slot (Tue 11:00 CET / 05:00 EDT) would be tough for our US engineering leads because they have an internal all-hands that day.

Can we do Wed Mar 17 10:00 CET / 06:00 EDT instead? That gets our US engineers in at a reasonable hour and keeps EMEA comfortable. Also can you include someone from Security for a 10–15 min Q&A at the end?
